decisions.reason: This dismantling joint is very close to the firm's core pipeline and valve business, so existing technical knowledge and customer access make it easier to learn from market feedback and improve it.

Although the firm can fabricate and powder-coat it, a public waste bin is commercially more distant from its infrastructure-focused knowledge base and customer problem-solving routines, so learning and sustained commitment are weaker.

The waste bin with ashtray is also outside the firm's established pipeline application domain, and with no clear sign of strong in-house R&D or research cooperation the firm is less likely to keep developing such a distant offering.

Outdoor public ashtrays are the most peripheral to the firm's established water and wastewater component business, making them the hardest to interpret, improve, and justify versus concentrating resources on core products.
